recorded.prompt:q-saidi: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-saidi: SAIDI "is the customer-minutes ... divided by the customers served": 3,000 x 240 / 150,000 = 4.8.
recorded.prompt:q-expected-cost: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-expected-cost: "No single year costs $258.9k; every year costs either 0 or $2,734k." Risk is an average over many years.
recorded.prompt:q-repairable: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-repairable: "failures(a) = Lambda(a+1) - Lambda(a)"; "the expected yearly cost is CoF x expected failures": 1.2 x 50 = 60.

recorded.prompt:q-saidi:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-saidi:a: Customers interrupted divided by customers served is SAIFI ("4,200 / 120,000 = 0.035 to SAIFI").
recorded.prompt:q-saidi:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-saidi:b: The SAIDI definition divides customer-minutes by the customers served, not by those interrupted.
recorded.prompt:q-saidi:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-saidi:c: SAIDI is customer-minutes "divided by the customers served".
recorded.prompt:q-expected-cost:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-expected-cost:a: Risk is "the average cost per year over many imagined repetitions ..., not the cost of any actual year".
recorded.prompt:q-expected-cost:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-expected-cost:c: "risk(a) = PoF(a) x CoF", not the CoF alone.
recorded.prompt:q-expected-cost:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-expected-cost:d: "any one year costs 0 or the CoF", so a year can cost $5,000k.
recorded.prompt:q-repairable:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-repairable:a: "If each failure costs CoF, the expected yearly cost is CoF x expected failures, not CoF x PoF."
recorded.prompt:q-repairable:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-repairable:b: The expected count is the difference Lambda(a+1) - Lambda(a), not Lambda at the year's end.
recorded.prompt:q-repairable:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-repairable:d: "at age 40 the invented asset fails 1.66 times a year on average". The count is not cut to one.
